description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for serializing, writing, reading, and unserializing data with integrity checks, specifically designed for SuiteCRM. It defines constants, security checks, and two main functions: suite_file_put_serialized_contents and suite_file_get_unserialized_contents.

methods.name: suite_file_put_serialized_contents
methods.description: Serializes data, appends a hash for integrity, and writes to a specified file.

methods.name: suite_file_get_unserialized_contents
methods.description: Reads, verifies, and unserializes data from a specified file, with integrity checks.
